text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic {Lightning} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

attacks.name: Frost Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Euclase
attacks.text: Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has exactly 6 damage counters on it.

rules.label: Tera
rules.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Articuno

attacks.name: Frigid Fluttering
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {Water} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

text.name: Delibird
text.flavor: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

text.name: Cryogonal

attacks.name: Call Sign
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Cryogonal uses its chains of ice to constrict its opponents and then flash-freezes them where they stand.

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Colorful Friends
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

text.name: Crabominable

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Food Prep
abilities.text: Attacks used by this Pokémon cost {Colorless} less for each Kofu card in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Haymaker
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Haymaker.

text.flavor: Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon's movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

text.name: Vanillish
text.flavor: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching –148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.
